item.description: Carlton have weathered wet and wild conditions to leap into the AFLW's top four with a 12-point win over Hawthorn.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Firmus reportedly targets $7.1b raise in blockbuster IPO
item.description: The Australian share market is set to rebound after Wall Street recovered from early losses as US Treasury yields retreated from multi-decade highs. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

item.title: ABC News: Trade minister proposes super investment in US lamb to dodge tariffs
item.description: Trade Minister Don Farrell asks the Trump administration to consider sparing Australian sheep farmers from future tariffs in exchange for Australian investment in America's lamb industry.

item.title: ABC News: Perth man jailed for AI-generated child exploitation material
item.description: Matthew John Woodward, 41, had pleaded guilty to dozens of counts of creating and possessing child exploitation material, which the District Court of Western Australia judge said was "appalling".

item.title: ABC News: Live: Gaming giants told to 'lift their game' on child safety
item.description: The eSafety Commission says it has identified gaps in harmful content detection, repeat-offender prevention and information-sharing initiatives in some gaming platforms. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: Volunteers unite to help strangers and find Nannup Four
item.description: A team of citizen searchers has travelled from across the country to dense bushland in Western Australia's south in a bid to find the Nannup Four.

item.title: ABC News: Australia and India to kick off next year's Cricket World Cup
item.description: Australia will launch its defence of the men's Cricket World Cup in South Africa next year with a blockbuster opener against India, the powerhouse it defeated to win the crown in 2023.

item.title: ABC News: Tasmania's notorious St Marys Pass upgrade could cost almost $3b
item.description: A notoriously windy stretch of road in Tasmania could be upgraded with pricing revealed to be as high as $2.7 billion to re-route the road.

item.title: ABC News: 'Way better than it sounds': The laksa-inspired dishes selling out in Darwin
item.description: From laksa cheesecake to toasties and deep fried ice cream, Darwin's annual laksa festival has something for all palettes. And while it might sound "weird", those cooking up a storm promise "it tastes way better than it sounds".

item.title: ABC News: Western Sydney home owners 'battening down the hatches'
item.description: Between interest rate and petrol price rises and falling house values, Western Sydney residents say making ends meet is getting tough.

item.title: ABC News: Brisbane to Melbourne with no traffic lights, and no Big Banana
item.description: Businesses in Coffs Harbour are preparing for life without 35,000 vehicles driving daily through the city.

item.title: ABC News: Sarah Sutter was an inaugural Thunderbird, now her daughter is making history
item.description: Jazmin Mckay has joined the Adelaide Thunderbirds as the club's inaugural mother-daughter signing, following in the footsteps of her mother, a dual premiership T-Bird and gold medal winning Diamond player.

item.title: ABC News: Australian citrus growers miss out on millions without US export markets
item.description: There are calls for government departments to speed up decades-old negotiations as markets in Asian countries worsen and Australia faces citrus oversupply.

item.title: ABC News: How to prepare for daylight saving time
item.description: This weekend, many Australians will experience a time warp, with their clocks jumping forward by an hour on Sunday morning.

item.title: ABC News: PNG's NRL franchise faces trademark fight over Chiefs name
item.description: Australia's intellectual property agency tells PNG's rugby league franchise that its chosen name, the Chiefs, risks being confused with the name of a Super Rugby club.

item.title: ABC News: Police investigating accused paedophile's links to celebrated charity
item.description: Australian and Cambodian police are jointly investigating accused paedophile Mark Dennis's network and links to a celebrated Cambodian charity following his death after being charged with possessing child abuse material.

item.title: ABC News: South-east faces flooding, storms after second-driest September on record
item.description: After a warm and dry start to spring, heavy rain is expected to sweep across south-east Australia this weekend.
